opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who will coordinate the visit; some specialist arts institutions permitted. The host institution must administer the grant. Visitors who have previously held a Leverhulme Visiting Professorship can apply only if at least 7 years have elapsed.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK. Priority given to new or recent collaborations with activities beyond research. Visits last 3-12 months; grants £10,000-£150,000.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible by UKRI. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution. Up to three co-applicants allowed.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project, up to 5 years. Two-stage process: outline applications (currently paused, to reopen autumn 2026 in new grants management system) and detailed applications (open until 1 September 2026). At least 75% of resources for research staff.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000 (scheme value); Trust contributes 100% of Fellow's salary up to £56,000 in year one and 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per year research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must hold a doctorate; thesis submitted for viva no more than 4 years before closing date. Tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers. Candidates who have held postdoctoral positions pursuing their own research totalling 3+ years are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, based on joint support with host university. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027. All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disabilities in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (Centenary)

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK university holding research degree awarding powers in its own right, or a consortium of up to two universities. A university may submit one application as lead but may partner in multiple applications in different disciplinary areas.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (18 at UK/home rates and 6 at international rates, plus up to 6 master's-plus-PhD studentships for underrepresented groups) in an interdisciplinary priority research area. Each grant runs over 9 years. Page states the Centenary round is now open for submission in March 2026.
discipline_tags: All research areas except excluded categories

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the duration of the Fellowship; resident in the UK at time of application; permanent member of the UK scholarly community with an established track record. Priority to those whose teaching/administrative duties have impacted their research.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable for 3-24 months. Approximately 100 Fellowships offered each year. Application materials will be available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; must live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year and hold or have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university with research degree awarding powers or a UKRI-eligible Independent Research Organisation/Institute at retirement. Must have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Fellowships tenable for 3-24 months. Application materials will be available on the page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities defined as institutions registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be based at a single university or be a collaboration between multiple institutions; international participation encouraged.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027. Two-stage process (outline and detailed proposal).

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary)

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career scholars embarking on a university career; at least two years full-time or equivalent experience in a research or teaching post after PhD; already hold a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent (or be nominated with a contract offered). Must not have held an equivalent award/fellowship establishing an independent research group, project grant funding over £100k, or led a team of research staff. Applicants at Senior Lecturer/Reader/Professor level not eligible.
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4-5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028. Each institution limited to one bid.
discipline_tags: Any research area except excluded categories
